steps.content: Euphoria's detention cell. There's nothing in the darkness but dust, mildew, and the coppery tang of blood.
And the sound of faint breathing.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Oh well. I'm locked up again. At least they went easier on me today. It'll heal fast. Mr. E gave me the meds. He says I have more performing to do, with everything going on...
There's a small, round porthole above the frail woman. She hopes to catch a glimpse of the world outside. But no.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Where's the moon? Why won't it come out? It's so dark in here, I can't see a thing... I hope my candle is still where I hid it...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: There it is! Looks like this is still my private hideout.
She clears a small space and carefully lights the candle. The matches are damp, and it takes many tries before a weak flame flickers to life, pushing back the shadows.
She wipes her dusty, blood-caked hands on her dress before pulling a small metal box from her bodice with reverent care. Twisting open the lid, she gazes at the photograph resting inside.
Milly gently traces the image with her fingertips, and a smile returns to her eyes.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, my dear, I've come to see you again. So much has happened these last two days, I haven't had time to really talk to you. You aren't mad with me, are you?

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Hehe, don't be mad. I can't wait to tell you everything. I had three performances, learned two new songs and a dance, and heard sixteen new stories. Oh... and I made a new friend.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Her name is Sallie. She's a wonderful dancer, and she's so smart and strong. Even when they push her around, she never bows her head. She even tried to escape. Isn't that brave? She's amazing.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: And what's more, she loves someone with all her heart, just like I do. When I look at her, I feel... a connection. It's love that makes her so brave, so strong, isn't it? I like her so much.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: But courage alone isn't enough. If she keeps charging ahead like that, she's going to get into real trouble. She hasn't been through this before. She won't survive it. I know too well...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Even Sinners who try to escape... get killed by Mr. E. She's putting herself in danger.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: So... I told him I was the one who took the communicator. Hehe. He's used to beating me up. I'm used to it, too... *cough*
Her voice grows a little louder, and blood catches in her throat. The feeble flame gutters with her coughs, nearly going out.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: ... I promised I'd make myself pretty for when you come, and here I am, making a mess of myself again... But my friend was in danger. I couldn't just sit back and watch...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: But don't worry, I'll be fine. Hehe. I'm tough, I can take a beating... I'm waiting for you, after all.
The tiny flame steadies itself again, its gentle light illuminating the corner where Milly sits, casting her face in a warm, tranquil glow.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: As long as I have you, I'm not afraid of anything... So please, come to my side. I miss you so much...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I want to see you so much, ${PlayerName}...

The moon finally rises, its light streaming through the porthole and blanketing her in a pale sheen. If she looked up now, she might see the stars twinkling in the sky, the moonlight dancing on the white sand like waves shimmering in the ocean.
But the girl's eyes are already closed. Beside her only treasure, she slips into unconsciousness.
